BaseTransform.description: A 4x4 matrix as 4 columns of 4 numbers, as a placement's `transform` is given (the translation is the last column): finite, affine (the fourth number of the first three columns is 0, of the last column 1) and invertible.

LengthExpr.description: A length: a number in the design's length unit, or an expression such as "w / 2" or "30 mm".

MatrixTolerance.description: A number above 0 and at most 0.001.

MoveAngle.description: An angle in radians (a number) or an angle expression such as "30 deg".

MoveMatrix.description: A rigid move as a row-major 3x4 (12 numbers) or 4x4 (16 numbers) matrix, flat or as 3 or 4 rows of 4.

MoveSpace.description: Which frame `occurrence.move` reads its move in: `local` or `world`.

MoveTo.description: `occurrence.move`'s `to`: a placement as a position and a turn about an axis through it.

angle.description: The turn about `axis`: radians, or an angle expression. Default: 0.

axis.description: The axis of its turn from the frame's axes. Default: Z.

position.description: Where the occurrence's origin goes, in mm.

OccurrencePath.description: An exact placement path: 1 to 64 occurrence ids from the root down.

OccurrenceRef.description: An occurrence's id (a number) or its name.

Point3.description: A point in mm: [x, y, z] or {"x", "y", "z"}.

PointExpr3.description: A point: [x, y, z] or {"x", "y", "z"}, each a number in mm or a length expression.

input.description:
Move an occurrence: by `translate`, or turned by `angle` about `axis` through `origin`, or by
a rigid `matrix` instead of those. Nested occurrences' definitions stay shared. A grounded
occurrence refuses unless `move_grounded` is true. When joints hold it to something fixed and
put it back, the reply says so (`reverted`).

angle.description: The turn about `axis`: radians, or an angle expression. Default: 0. Not with `matrix`.

axis.description: The axis to turn about, not zero when `angle` is. Default: Z. Not with `matrix`.

base_transform.description:
The transform the move starts from, in place of the occurrence's current one (what a drag
in the Browser passes).

capture.description:
`true` makes the move the occurrence's placement now; `false` keeps it pending until
`component.capture_position`. Default: `true`.

matrix.description:
A rigid move instead of `translate`, `axis`, `angle` and `origin`: a rotation and a
translation. One that is a rotation only up to `tolerance` is made exact; a scale, shear or
mirror is refused.

move_grounded.description: `true` moves a grounded occurrence, which stays grounded. Default: `false`, which refuses.

occurrence.description: The occurrence, by id or name.

origin.description: The point the turn is about, in mm. Default: the origin. Not with `matrix`.

path.description:
The occurrence's exact placement, as occurrence ids from the top of the design (1 to 64),
ending in `occurrence`. Needed with `space: world` for a placement inside a component
placed more than once.

space.description:
The frame of the move: `local` is the parent's (the placement's own), `world` is world
coordinates. Default: `local`.

to.description:
Absolute placement (#12150): where the occurrence goes in `space`, not a move. Not with
`translate`, `axis`, `angle`, `origin`, `matrix`, `to_matrix` or `base_transform`.

to_matrix.description:
Absolute placement as a rigid matrix, in the form `matrix` takes: where the occurrence goes
in `space`, not a move. Not with `translate`, `axis`, `angle`, `origin`, `matrix`, `to` or
`base_transform`.

tolerance.description:
With `matrix` or `to_matrix`: the largest accepted |RᵀR − I| per entry. Default: 1e-9.
Read only with those.

translate.description: Move by this much, in mm. Default: no move. Not with `matrix`.

input.title: MoveParams

label: Move Occurrence

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

pending.description: Whether the move is pending, not captured.

reverted.description:
Present, and `true`, when joints hold the occurrence to something fixed and put it back:
`transform` is where it is.

transform.description: Its placement in its parent now, as a 4×4 matrix (its pending one with `capture: false`).

warning.description: With `reverted`: the joint that holds it and what to change instead.

params: occurrence; path?: exact placement; space?: local|world (default local); translate?: [x,y,z] (numbers or length expressions: an occurrence moved by expressions that name parameters keeps them and moves with them when the parameters change, along the axes the move was given in; other moves of it stay; a parameter they use can't be deleted, and a renamed one carries into them); axis?: [x,y,z], angle?: radians or "30 deg", origin?: [x,y,z]; to?: {position: [x,y,z], axis?: [x,y,z], angle?} or to_matrix?: [12 or 16 numbers] (absolute placement: where it goes in space, not a move; not with translate/axis/angle/origin/matrix); matrix?: [12 or 16 numbers] (instead of translate/axis/angle/origin: a rigid move as a row-major 3x4 rotation-and-translation or 4x4 matrix, flat or as rows; one that is a rotation only up to rounding is orthonormalised, a scale, shear or mirror is refused); tolerance?: largest accepted |RᵀR − I| (default 1e-9, at most 1e-3); capture?: bool (default true; false keeps it pending until Capture Position); move_grounded?: bool (default false: a grounded occurrence refuses; true moves it and it stays grounded). Nested occurrence definitions remain shared. Replies {occurrence, transform, pending}; when joints hold it to something fixed and put it back, transform is where it is and the reply adds reverted: true and a warning naming the joint
